story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번엔 깊고 구수한 맛의 고장, 남도 상공이에요. 정성 가득한 상차림을 만나보세요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon-en gip-go gu-su-han mas-ui go-jang, nam-do sang-gong-i-e-yo. jeong-seong ga-deuk-han sang-cha-rim-eul man-na-bo-se-yo.
story.en: Passengers, this time it's above Namdo, a land of deep, savory flavor. Come meet a table setting full of care.

story.text: 남도를 대표하는 밥상, '한정식'이에요. 밥과 국은 물론, 수십 가지 반찬이 정성스레 차려진답니다.
story.reading: nam-do-reul dae-pyo-ha-neun bap-sang, han-jeong-sig-i-e-yo. bap-gwa gug-eun mul-lon, su-sip ga-ji ban-chan-i jeong-seong-seu-re cha-ryeo-jin-dam-ni-da.
story.en: The table setting that represents Namdo is 'hanjeongsik'. Along with rice and soup, dozens of side dishes are carefully served.

story.text: 그 많은 반찬 중 빠질 수 없는 게 '김치'예요. 배추를 소금에 절이고 양념에 버무려 발효시킨 우리 대표 음식이지요.
story.reading: geu manh-eun ban-chan jung ppa-jil su eob-neun ge gim-chi-ye-yo. bae-chu-reul so-geum-e jeol-i-go yang-nyeom-e beo-mu-ryeo bal-hyo-si-kin u-ri dae-pyo eum-sig-i-ji-yo.
story.en: Among those many side dishes, one that can't be missed is 'kimchi'. It's our representative food, made by salting cabbage and fermenting it with seasoning.

story.text: 구수한 찌개의 비밀은 '된장'이에요. 콩을 삶아 메주로 띄운 뒤 오랫동안 발효시켜 만든답니다.
story.reading: gu-su-han jji-gae-ui bi-mil-eun doen-jang-i-e-yo. kong-eul salm-a me-ju-ro ttui-un dwi o-raet-dong-an bal-hyo-si-kyeo man-deun-dam-ni-da.
story.en: The secret of a savory stew is 'doenjang'. It's made by boiling soybeans, forming them into meju, and fermenting them for a long time.

story.text: 김치에 깊은 맛을 더하는 건 '젓갈'이에요. 생선이나 새우를 소금에 삭혀 만든 감칠맛 나는 양념이랍니다.
story.reading: gim-chi-e gip-eun mas-eul deo-ha-neun geon jeot-gal-i-e-yo. saeng-seon-i-na sae-u-reul so-geum-e sak-hyeo man-deun gam-chil-mat na-neun yang-nyeom-i-ram-ni-da.
story.en: What adds a deep flavor to kimchi is 'jeotgal'. It's a savory seasoning made by salting and fermenting fish or shrimp.

story.text: 이런 발효 음식들은 '장독대'에서 익어가요. 볕 잘 드는 마당에 항아리를 줄지어 놓고 시간을 담아낸답니다.
story.reading: i-reon bal-hyo eum-sik-deul-eun jang-dok-dae-e-seo ig-eo-ga-yo. byeot jal deu-neun ma-dang-e hang-a-ri-reul jul-ji-eo noh-go si-gan-eul dam-a-nae-ndam-ni-da.
story.en: These fermented foods ripen at the 'jangdokdae' (sauce jar terrace). Jars are lined up in a sunny yard, letting time do its work.

story.text: 자, 깊은 맛의 다섯 단어를 모두 맛보셨나요? 이제 구수하게 문제를 풀어봐요!
story.reading: ja, gip-eun mas-ui da-seot dan-eo-reul mo-du mat-bo-syeot-na-yo? i-je gu-su-ha-ge mun-je-reul pul-eo-bwa-yo!
story.en: Now, have you tasted all five deep-flavored words? Let's solve some questions with a savory spirit!

words.example_en: Many side dishes are served with hanjeongsik.
Kimchi is a representative fermented food.
You make a savory stew with doenjang.
Jeotgal adds savory flavor to kimchi.
Jars are lined up on the sauce jar terrace.

sentences.en: Hanjeongsik is a table setting full of care.
Kimchi keeps its flavor even after a long time.
Doenjang is fermented for a long time.
Jeotgal is salty and full of savory flavor.

sentences.ko: 장독대는 햇볕 잘 드는 곳에 둬요.
sentences.reading: jang-dok-dae-neun haet-byeot jal deu-neun gos-e dwo-yo
sentences.en: The jar terrace is placed where sunlight reaches well.
